india_context.procedural_notes: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, the data controller is termed 'Data Fiduciary' and the processor 'Data Processor'. A Data Fiduciary remains primarily liable for breaches committed by its Processor.
india_context.transitional_notes: Rules and penalty schedules under DPDPA to be notified; legacy Section 43A of IT Act 2000 applies until formal repeal takes effect.
verification_requirements: Confirm processor contract mandates immediate breach notification to Fiduciary to meet Data Protection Board timelines.
